business_profile.business_overview: Ngital is a results-driven digital marketing agency in Dhaka, founded in 2020 by Tajul Islam, serving 200+ brands with senior-led pods and weekly delivery. Services span SEO, performance marketing, social media, content, creative production, web development, Shopify ecommerce, and WhatsApp marketing. They offer a 'Free 30-Min Strategy Audit' as their lead magnet, promising a reply within 1 business day and a senior strategist on the call. They partner with founders, marketing leaders, and global teams. Retainer-based clients (BDT 50K+/month typical for agencies). Their own intake depends on inbound forms + the audit offer.

business_profile.competitive_position: Ngital competes with other Dhaka digital agencies for retainer clients. Their edge is senior-led pods and measurable performance marketing. But their own intake (1-business-day reply, manual audit qualification) lags the AI-powered experience they could offer. Adopting an AI intake agent would both win them more retainers AND become a case study they sell to clients.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With 200+ brands and retainer pricing, each converted audit is recurring monthly revenue. If slow/manual audit qualification loses even a few retainer clients per quarter — and senior time is burned on unqualified calls — that's meaningful lost MRR plus wasted capacity. An AI qualification + scheduling agent recovers this and frees senior strategists for closing.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI audit-qualification agent that scores each inbound request by budget, goals, and fit before a strategist is involved.
2. Audit scheduling agent that books qualified prospects into strategist calendars with reminders.
3. Proposal + onboarding automation that turns closed audits into retainers faster.
4. Past-client re-engagement agent that surfaces upsell opportunities across the 200+ brand base.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A founder submits a Free Audit request at 10pm. In seconds the AI replies: 'Thanks! To match you with the right senior strategist: what's your monthly ad budget, and is your goal leads, sales, or brand?' The founder answers; the AI scores them as high-fit and books a 30-min audit for tomorrow 2pm with a prep brief already sent. The strategist walks in prepared, and Ngital responded instantly — practicing the AI-powered growth it sells.
